description: This file defines hooks for component testing with Playwright in a Vue.js setup, including setup functions for before and after mounting components, importing router, Button component, and styles.

methods.name: beforeMount
methods.description: Hook function executed before mounting a component, adds router and button component to the app, and logs configuration.

methods.name: afterMount
methods.description: Hook function executed after mounting a component, logs the component's root element.
